note: Raw control byte U+0001 (SOH) appears unescaped inside a quoted segment. Sec 4's <dq-char> exclusion list forbids control bytes below 0x20 other than tab/VT/FF exactly as <key-char> does for bare segments (Sec 5.3.3): quoting relaxes which STRUCTURAL bytes need escaping, not the format's separate prohibition on raw invisible bytes in a key. The byte is only representable via \u0001.
